request.subject: UNIT:MARTIAN:EMBARKED_TRANSPORT

layers.text: Rebuild it as a retro sci-fi hover-barge: the wooden hull becomes smooth rounded polished chrome and silver-white metal shaded soft blue-grey, with a dark gunmetal underside; the oars and the pole are removed; the red tarp becomes a long clear pale glass canopy dome over the cargo with one white highlight; small glowing hot magenta lights at the bow and stern. Keep the boat shape, size, thick black outline and style exactly the same, with nothing under the hull.
